info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking It Management Production Release By Production Release Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables the modification of existing production releases within the Banking IT Management system by their unique identifiers. It allows authorized users to adjust critical release parameters, ensuring that production environments reflect the latest changes effectively. Common consumers include DevOps teams and system administrators who need to manage software deployments efficiently. This API supports seamless updates, contributing to the agility and reliability of banking applications.

patch.summary: Update the production release for the specified item.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific production release in the IT management system. Use this to modify attributes associated with the release, ensuring that the relevant information is current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the production release details for the specified ticket 'PROD-700045'. It contains the necessary fields to modify the existing production release information.
